title: startContainer hook paths should use container namespace
body:
Hi :)

I was trying to use the `startContainer` w/ podman. Using a simple `Containerfile`

```Containerfile
FROM docker.io/library/alpine
ADD hook.sh /hook.sh
RUN chmod +x /hook.sh
```

`hook.sh`
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env sh
echo test >> /tmp/hook-out
```

And this hook:
```json
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "hook": {
    "path": "/hook.sh"
  },
  "when": {
    "always": true
  },
  "stages": ["startContainer"]
}
```

<details>
<summary>Here is also a little script to make it easier to run:</summary>

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
IMAGE="localhost/hook-test:latest"

buildah build -t "$IMAGE"

mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR/hooks"
cat > "$PROJECT_DIR/hooks/hook.json" <<EOF
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "hook": {
    "path": "/hook.sh"
  },
  "when": {
    "always": true
  },
  "stages": ["startContainer"]
}
EOF


podman run --rm \
  --hooks-dir="$PROJECT_DIR/hooks" \
  --entrypoint cat \
  "$IMAGE" /tmp/hook-out
```
</details>

This then fails because the hook is never executed:

```log
$ ./run-hook.sh
STEP 1/3: FROM docker.io/library/alpine
STEP 2/3: ADD hook.sh /hook.sh
STEP 3/3: RUN chmod +x /hook.sh
COMMIT localhost/hook-test:latest
Getting image source signatures
Copying blob 75c137aedfb2 skipped: already exists
Copying blob 3a0671a3e61b done   |
Copying config 5f70033a9c done   |
Writing manifest to image destination
--> 5f70033a9c8a
Successfully tagged localhost/hook-test:latest
5f70033a9c8a9bb249098eafce9989d4871f612f5b9666eca2b1d9ea350a3ee1
cat: can't open '/tmp/hook-out': No such file or directory
```

The hook silently fails as it tries to find `/hook.sh` on the host machine. [The OpenContainers Runtime Spec Config](https://specs.opencontainers.org/runtime-spec/config/#startcontainer-hooks) says that the `startContainer` hook should use the `containerNamespace` (links are broken in docs):

> The startContainer hooks' path MUST resolve in the [container namespace](https://specs.opencontainers.org/runtime-spec/config/glossary.md#container-namespace). The startContainer hooks MUST be executed in the [container namespace](https://specs.opencontainers.org/runtime-spec/config/glossary.md#container-namespace).

I think it could make sense to leave the checking, if the binary exists in the container namespace, to the OCI runtime.

### Expected behavior

A hook used exclusively for `startContainer` should not be required to exist in the runtime namespace. Its executable should be resolved and validated by the OCI runtime in the container namespace.

### Relevant code
https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/blob/a51a93f17ac94b6867afed1099053d27efd2b95b/common/pkg/hooks/1.0.0/hook.go#L47-L49
